rule.title: Intent-Revealing, Searchable Identifiers
rule.statement: Variable and function names must clearly express their intent, domain concept, and unit of measurement without requiring external comments.
rule.rationale: Obscure names (e.g. data, temp, flag, d) force readers to scan entire files to deduce meaning, slowing down debugging and review.
rule.implementation_guidance: Include units in variable names where ambiguous (timeoutMs, maxFileSizeMb). Prefix booleans with is/has/can/should.

forbidden.example: const flag = false; const timeout = 5000; const data2 = getData();

source.book_title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
source.evidence_quote: The name of a variable, function, or class, should answer all the big questions. It should tell you why it exists, what it does, and how it is used.
